properties.name: Tell es-Sultan
properties.note: Ancient Jericho. Mound approximately 270 by 150 m. EAMENA record: EAMENA-0116641 (6 m)

properties.name: Tulul Abu el-ʿAlayiq, southern mound
properties.note: Plan test with Netzer 1975 fig. 2; sunken garden wall, pool B107. EAMENA record: EAMENA-0117120 (56 m)

properties.name: Birket Musa
properties.note: 174 by 143 m on the image; Survey 172 by 144 m. EAMENA record: EAMENA-0117122 (37 m)

properties.name: Quruntul, summit enclosure
properties.note: Modern wall with the unfinished church; not the ancient fort (Meshel 1978). EAMENA record: EAMENA-0117189 (148 m)

properties.name: Nebi Musa
properties.note: Ground plan by V. Pirsky (Daʿadli 2020, fig. 9) agrees with the image of 1 Dec 1974 with scale from its bar, north from its arrow and one anchor (north-east corner): outer walls, inner court and south range to 3 to 6 m. No EAMENA record within 400 m. Checklist record sit0057

properties.name: Deir Hajla
properties.note: Position, size and layout; compound 40 by 70 m in 1974. Same form on 5 May 1978: south block 39 by 37 m with dome mark, north court 26 by 34 m. Dark spot at this place on CORONA 26 Sep 1967. EAMENA record: EAMENA-0117124 (30 m)
properties.altNames: Monastery of St Gerasimus, Qasr Hajla

properties.name: Khirbet Qumran
properties.note: Plan test with Magen and Peleg 2007 fig. 4. EAMENA record: EAMENA-0117926 (76 m)

properties.name: ʿEin Feshkha building
properties.note: Plan tests with Humbert and Chambon pl. XLIII and Hirschfeld 2004 fig. 3. EAMENA record: EAMENA-0117992 (91 m)

properties.name: Hyrcania (Khirbet el-Mird)
properties.source: image, tile F018b; summit of the elevation model 28 m
properties.note: Reservoirs and fort Checked with plans of Wright and Patrich; aqueduct course mostly not identified. EAMENA record: EAMENA-0117997 (33 m)

properties.name: Mar Saba
properties.note: Position only

properties.name: Khirbet Mazin
properties.source: image, tile F018b (three-point transform with shift)
properties.note: Compared with the orthophoto of HA 136 (2024)

properties.name: Plateau Fort
properties.note: 50.5 by 49.5 m; no cistern recorded. Square outline also on CORONA 26 Sep 1967. EAMENA record: EAMENA-0184448 "Matabi" (117 m)

properties.name: Habbasa
properties.note: Row of roofless chambers, approximately 50 m; plan test with Prag and Barnes fig. 9. EAMENA record: EAMENA-0185957 (70 m)

properties.name: Barakat
properties.note: Grid reference in Prag and Barnes is 340 to 385 m south of this place (probable error in the paper). EAMENA record: EAMENA-0184843 (31.85302 N, 35.67183 E; 144 m west of the fort on the image, at the same latitude)

properties.name: Kafrein dam, centre of the crest
properties.note: Control point; crest 469 m on the image, 480 m published. No dam and no water on CORONA 26 Sep 1967

properties.name: Tell Kafrein
properties.note: Control point. EAMENA record: EAMENA-0186072 (30 m)

properties.name: Tell el-Hammam, upper tell
properties.note: Control point; OpenStreetMap outline agrees. EAMENA record: EAMENA-0185516 (55 m)

properties.name: Tree group at the foot of Tell el-Hammam
properties.note: Probable place of the warm springs

properties.name: Umm Ḥadhar hill, dark patch
properties.note: Building Possible on HEXAGON; Checked by form on APAAME frames. EAMENA record: EAMENA-0185896 "tell haddar" (50 m)

properties.name: Tell er-Rameh
properties.source: elevation model = published point; image 45 to 95 m
properties.note: The round mound beside the straight road. EAMENA record: EAMENA-0185988 (13 m)

properties.name: Oval mound north-east of Tell er-Rameh
properties.note: Not Tell er-Rameh; no name

properties.name: Tell Iktanu
properties.note: Light oval hill north-west of the highway. EAMENA record: EAMENA-0185948 (46 m). Fort on the summit: Prag 1989 fig. 6 has it at −130 m (elevation model −128 m); Glueck gave 42 by 35 by 35 by 20 m; the rectangular outline of approximately 45 by 30 m on the image agrees

properties.name: Dark area east of the highway (fields)
properties.note: Light on CORONA 26 Sep 1967, dark on 25 Jun 1974: plants of one season. Not the south hill of Iktanu

properties.name: Road works beside the Dead Sea road
properties.note: Not ancient

properties.name: Machaerus, citadel hill
properties.source: elevation model summit (image position is 213 m west: relief displacement)
properties.note: Identified on the image of 1974 before the excavations of 1978 to 1981

properties.name: Tell es-Samarat
properties.status: Possible (1974); Checked on the frames of 1918
properties.source: direction and distance from Tell es-Sultan (Survey sheet): 210 degrees, 740 m
properties.note: Oval area of approximately 60 by 140 m in the fields in 1974

properties.name: Sugar mill (Tawahin es-Sukkar)
properties.status: Possible (1974); Checked on the frames of 1918
properties.source: direction and distance from Tell es-Sultan (Survey sheet): 285 degrees, 535 m
properties.note: Buildings with trees in 1974; old compound not separated from farm buildings

properties.name: ʿAin ez-Zara oasis (Callirrhoe)
properties.source: image, tile F018b east shore window (centre of the field area)
properties.note: Farmed plain with spring courses and no shore road in 1974; the excavated buildings are not identified on the image

properties.name: Canyon mouth with a round fan north of the oasis
properties.source: image, tile F018b east shore window
properties.note: Probable mouth of Wadi Zarqa Maʿin

properties.name: Jericho palaces, Pools Complex (two pools)
properties.note: Plan test with Netzer 2001 plan 14 (scale of the bar, one anchor, turn 13 degrees from the plan north); each pool approximately 18 by 14 m on the image

properties.name: Jericho palaces, northern wing of the third palace
properties.note: Plan test with Netzer 1975 fig. 2; agreement 10 to 20 m. Second test with Netzer 2001 plan 35 by the site grid; agreement 5 to 10 m
properties.altNames: Herod, Area north of Wadi Qelt

properties.name: Jericho palaces, Twin Palaces (Area AE)
properties.note: Plan test with Netzer 2001 plan 26 by the site grid (no free value; anchor and turn from plan 14); agreement 5 to 10 m on the image of 5 May 1978

properties.name: Jericho palaces, Area AA (Buried Palace and Fortified Palace)
properties.note: Netzer 2001 plan 11 by the site grid; trenches and rooms inside the frame of the plan; agreement 10 to 20 m

properties.name: Tell Iktanu, lower south hill
properties.source: image and elevation model: middle of the spur
properties.note: Long flat-topped spur, approximately 600 by 150 m, south-east of the highway, from south-west to north-east. Agrees with the description in Prag 2024 (Introduction) and with EAMENA-0184805 "iktanu south" (31.81589 N, 35.66924 E). Site plan (her Fig. 1.1) not seen. Prag 1989 fig. 1 (contour plan of the south hill): long hill beside the Dead Sea–Amman road, top at −144 m (elevation model −145 m)

properties.name: Jericho palaces, Herod's Second Palace (Areas AG and AL)
properties.note: Netzer 2001 plan 29 by the site grid; excavated rooms inside the frame of the plan, east of the Twin Palaces

properties.name: Jericho palaces, Area AC
properties.note: Netzer 2001 plan 12 by the site grid; west part of the palace mound

properties.name: Jericho palaces, Hasmonean Garden of the Pools Complex
properties.note: Open ground north of the pools on the image; no test is possible

properties.name: Tell Nimrin
properties.source: image, tile A017e (1 Dec 1974), window registered to the elevation model (26 blocks, 12 m)
properties.note: Topographic map of 1989 (Flanagan and McCreery 1990, fig. 4) agrees with scale from its bar, north from its arrow and one anchor: road cut, mound contours and the old school building, to approximately 10 m. Mound approximately 170 by 110 m. EAMENA-0184259 (40 m). Checklist record sit0308

properties.name: Shunat Nimrin, road junction
properties.source: CORONA DF041 d registered to HEXAGON A017e (43 blocks, 11 m)
properties.note: Same roads and walled compound in 1967 and 1974

properties.name: Suwwan
properties.kind: rubble mound on a spur (possible building)
properties.source: image, tile A017e (1 Dec 1974), Kafrein transform
properties.note: Dark speckled patch approximately 25 by 30 m on a spur top between two gullies. Agrees in size and ground form with 17 APAAME photographs of 28 Oct 2014 (title Suwwan; Flickr list position 231 m away). CORONA 1967 too light. No straight sides visible. No EAMENA record within 500 m Second image: HEXAGON A014c of June 1974, registered to the elevation model (25 blocks, 30 m), shows a group of dark spots at the east end of the same gully, at the same place to approximately 30 m. Checked for the presence of the stone patch on two images; no building form is visible.

properties.name: Karama Ruin 5 (Ain al-Heri)
properties.kind: building of two parts on a spur
properties.source: image, tile A017e (1 Dec 1974), window registered to the elevation model (155 blocks, 12 m)
properties.note: Two joined rectangles with dark wall lines, approximately 22 by 36 m and 36 by 24 m, on a flat spur top above a gorge with vegetation. Same form on APAAME photographs of 24 Sep 2017 (title Karama Ruin 5 / Heri / Ain al-Heri; Flickr list position 137 m away). No EAMENA record within 500 m Second image: HEXAGON A015c of June 1974 shows the same two joined rectangles.

properties.name: el-Heri Tower
properties.source: image, tile A017e (1 Dec 1974), window registered to the elevation model (155 blocks, 12 m)
properties.note: One oval ring approximately 10 m across on open ground south of a small wadi. APAAME photographs of 24 Sep 2017 show a small round stone structure on a plateau (Flickr list position 104 m away). No EAMENA record within 500 m Second image: HEXAGON A015c of June 1974 shows the same ring.

properties.name: Karama Ruins 14
properties.source: image, tile A017e (1 Dec 1974), window registered to the elevation model (155 blocks, 12 m)
properties.note: Round feature approximately 11 m across on a field plateau north of a gorge. APAAME photographs of 24 Sep 2017 show a ring of stones on a ploughed plateau near a gorge edge, with two small rectangular enclosures near it (Flickr list position 199 m away). No EAMENA record within 500 m HEXAGON A015c of June 1974 shows a faint light patch with one dark spot at the same place (weak). Second exposure: HEXAGON F017c (forward camera, 1 Dec 1974) shows the same round light feature with the same shadow and inner spot (block match 0.87). Checked on two exposures of the same day; June 1974 is weak.

properties.name: Karama Ruins 16
properties.source: image, tile A017e (1 Dec 1974), window registered to the elevation model (79 blocks, 10 m)
properties.note: Round light feature approximately 18 m across on a small flat-topped knoll above a scarp. APAAME photographs of 24 Sep 2017 show a ring on a flat-topped knoll above a scarp, and more rings on the plateau near it (Flickr list position 263 m away). No EAMENA record within 500 m Second image: HEXAGON F007d of 5 May 1978 shows the same knoll with a ring wall, clearer than in 1974.

properties.name: ʿAin Duk, head of the spring gardens
properties.source: images F016b (1 Dec 1974) and F006c (5 May 1978), each linked to a registered frame through the frame overlap (51 and 11 blocks)
properties.note: Trees and a small structure where the irrigated plots start, at the foot of the scarp; the two dates agree to 15 m. The water is not visible. EAMENA record: EAMENA-0117143 (3 m). The entry table uses this point from 11 Nov 2026; its old point (PEF sheet XVIII, georeferenced) is 415 m to the west-north-west on a bare slope.

properties.name: Tell el-Qos (published point)
properties.kind: tell in the built-up area of Jericho
properties.source: EAMENA-0117188; point shown on images F017b (1 Dec 1974) and F007c (5 May 1978)
properties.note: Open light ground approximately 60 m across on the north bank of Wadi Qelt in 1974; houses on a part of it in 1978. No mound shape can be read between the houses and trees. The entry table uses this point from 11 Nov 2026; its old point (PEF sheet XVIII, georeferenced) is 165 m to the north in an orchard with houses.

properties.name: Dome of the Rock (control for the Jerusalem window)
properties.source: published coordinate; the Jerusalem window of F017b is registered to the elevation model (141 blocks, 18 m with a height term) and then moved 48 m to put this point right
properties.note: With this one control, nine other landmarks with published coordinates (gates of the Old City, al-Aqsa, Holy Sepulchre, Church of All Nations) are at their places on the image, to approximately 30 m. The image of 5 May 1978 (F007c) is registered independently (30 blocks, 7 m with a height term; moved 19 m to this point): the same nine landmarks are at their places.

properties.name: Tell el-Ful, structure on the summit
properties.source: image, tile F017b (1 Dec 1974), Jerusalem window
properties.note: Terraced hill with a rectangular structure on the top. The entry-table point (Pleiades 749935552) is 8 m away. On the image of 5 May 1978 the point is approximately 35 m east of the centre of the large building on the summit.

properties.name: Machaerus, rectangle north-west of the citadel
properties.kind: rectangular enclosure with rounded corners (probable Roman siege camp)
properties.source: image, tile F018c (1 Dec 1974), Machaerus transform with height term
properties.note: Double line, approximately 65 m by 30 m, at the edge of a ridge above the wadi, 460 m west-north-west of the citadel summit. One date. The camp letter of the published siege plan is not assigned. South of the scroll region.

properties.name: Machaerus, rectangle south-west of the citadel
properties.kind: rectangular enclosure with rounded corners (probable Roman siege camp)
properties.source: image, tile F018c (1 Dec 1974), Machaerus transform with height term
properties.note: Double line, approximately 44 m by 30 m, at the edge of a ridge above the wadi, 550 m west-south-west of the citadel summit. One date. The camp letter of the published siege plan is not assigned. South of the scroll region.
